description: This file contains Python code for managing user data in the Open5GS mobile network system, including functions to add users, read subscriber data from CSV or string, and a command-line interface to process subscriber data and interact with the Open5GS database.

methods.name: add_user
methods.description: Constructs a subscriber data dictionary for a user to be added to Open5GS database.

methods.name: read_from_db
methods.description: Reads subscriber data from a CSV file and returns a list of subscriber dictionaries.

methods.name: read_from_string
methods.description: Parses a subscriber data string into a list containing a subscriber dictionary.
